storage_mode.description: Journal storage mode — 'auto', 'persistent', 'volatile', or 'none'. Choose 'persistent' to keep logs across reboots.

data_directory.description: Path to persistent journal data directory (e.g., '/var/log/journal'). Leave empty to use default.

runtime_directory.description: Path to volatile journal directory. Only used if `Storage=volatile`.

max_storage_use.description: Maximum disk space used by all journal files (e.g., '10%', '2G', '500M').

system_max_use.description: Maximum disk space used by system (non-user) journal data.

system_max_file_size.description: Maximum size per system journal file before rotation.

max_file_sec.description: Maximum age of individual journal files before rotation (duration, e.g., '7d', '1month').

max_retention_sec.description: How long journal entries are retained. Set to '0' to rely on disk usage limits.

max_files.description: Maximum number of journal files per stream before rotation.

min_free_space.description: Minimum free disk space required before journal stops writing (e.g., '500M').

min_file_sec.description: Minimum retention period for journal entries regardless of disk usage.

compress_threads.description: Number of threads for compression (0 = auto-detect).

seal.description: Enable journal sealing (requires keys) — not for typical use.

split_mode.description: How to split journals: 'uid' (per user), 'none' (single journal), or 'auto'.

sync_interval_sec.description: How often to sync journal metadata to disk (duration, e.g., '30s', '10m').

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum log messages allowed in the rate-limit interval.

remote_forward_enabled.description: Enable forwarding to remote syslog (e.g., rsyslog) over the network.

remote_syslog_host.description: Network address (host:port) for remote syslog forwarding (e.g., 'syslog.example.com:514').

forward_to_kmsg.description: Forward journal entries to kernel ring buffer (dmesg).

forward_to_console.description: Forward journal entries to system consoles (not recommended — use with caution).

console_level.description: Minimum log level forwarded to consoles — 'debug', 'info', 'notice', 'warning', 'err', 'crit', 'alert', 'emerg'.

console_rate_limit.description: Rate limit for console forwarding (only applies if `forward_to_console=yes`).

interval_sec.description: Time window for console rate limiting.

max_file_descriptors.description: Maximum file descriptors for journal clients (increase for many services).

binary_stream.description: Enable binary journal format in remote forwarding.

extra_fields.description: Additional static fields to include in all journal entries (e.g., environment tags).

storage_monitored_paths.description: List of paths (e.g., mount points) to monitor for storage health.

use_wall_clock.description: Use wall-clock (real-time) timestamps instead of monotonic clock.

runtime_state_dir.description: Directory for runtime journal state (e.g., sockets, headers).

journal_socket.description: Path to journal client socket (for stdout redirection).

stdout_socket.description: Path to stdout socket used by services with StandardOutput=journal.

json.description: Use JSON format for remote forwarding (required for some SIEMs).

json_seal.description: Enable sealing of JSON-forwarded batches (requires keys).

rate_limit_allowed_ips.description: Allow journal forwarding only from these CIDR ranges (e.g., ['10.0.0.0/8']).

workers.description: Number of worker threads for journal processing.

deduplicate.description: Enable deduplication of identical consecutive messages.

immediate_flush.description: Flush journal metadata immediately after every change.

remote_journal_enabled.description: Enable forwarding to remote journald service (via systemd-journal-remote).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate file for encrypted remote forwarding.

tls_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key file.

tls_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for verifying remote servers.
